quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your reflexes and judgment?

options.text: Beer has less effect than wine.
Wine has less effect than beer.
Hard ciders and mixed drinks have the most effect.
It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: Any type of alcohol hurts your reflexes and judgment. The type of alcohol does not matter. Only the amount of alcohol in your bloodstream matters.

questions.question: What does an orange triangle on the back of a vehicle mean?

options.text: The vehicle moves slower than normal traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle moves slower than normal traffic.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle is shown on farm tractors and horse-drawn vehicles. These vehicles travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes on a highway?

options.text: Check your rearview and side mirrors.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, signal early, check your mirrors, and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. This helps keep you safe.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver should continue without stopping.
One driver should wave others ahead.

questions.explanation: All drivers must stop at a four-way stop. The first vehicle to arrive goes first. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the right goes first.

questions.question: What happens if someone under 16 uses a fake ID to buy alcohol?

options.text: Their driving license will be suspended when they turn 16.
They cannot take the driver's test until they turn 21.
Their driving license will be suspended when they turn 21.
They must attend an alcohol safety class.

questions.correctAnswerText: Their driving license will be suspended when they turn 16.
questions.explanation: If you are under 21 and are convicted of using fake ID to get alcohol, your driving privilege will be suspended. If you are under 16, the suspension starts on your 16th birthday.

questions.question: What should you do after a train passes?

options.text: Look for other trains and proceed carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for other trains and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: After one train passes, always check for other approaching trains before crossing the tracks. Even at single-track crossings, another train could be coming.

questions.question: What usually causes hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: When you drive too fast, your tires cannot clear water from the road. They lose grip and slide on water. This is called hydroplaning.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights?

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Pull to the right side and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right side and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, pull over to the right side of the road and stop immediately.

questions.question: How do you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, let other traffic go first, and match their speed.
Signal and enter. Other traffic must yield.
Drive slowly so you can check traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let other traffic go first, and match their speed.
questions.explanation: When entering a freeway, signal your intention. Let other traffic pass first and merge at the same speed they are traveling.

questions.question: How can you help prevent crashes?
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers do unexpected things. Communicate with other drivers, bicyclists, and pedestrians by signaling when you slow down, stop, or turn. Use your horn or emergency lights when needed.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light at an intersection mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and be ready to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: What should you do when a truck driver behind you wants to pass?

options.text: Your speed should remain steady or decrease.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your speed should remain steady or decrease.
questions.explanation: When a truck is passing you, slow down slightly and keep your speed steady. Never speed up while the truck is passing you.

questions.question: After an emergency vehicle with its siren on passes you, what must you do?

options.text: Drive closely behind the emergency vehicle.
Drive as quickly as the emergency vehicle.
Stay at least 500 feet behind the emergency vehicle.
Drive very slowly near the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay at least 500 feet behind the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: After an emergency vehicle passes you, you must keep at least 500 feet between your vehicle and the emergency vehicle.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards on the road. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes traveling in the same direction. Solid white lines should not be crossed. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: If you need to slow down or stop unexpectedly, what should you do first?

options.text: Quickly tap your brake pedal a few times.
Look over your shoulder for traffic in your blind spot.
Get ready to blow your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Quickly tap your brake pedal a few times.
questions.explanation: Quickly tap your brake pedal three or four times to warn other drivers that you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.
